question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"self-sufficiency"** means the ability to fulfill one's needs without external assistance. (आत्मनिर्भरता)

 
 
• **Example:** The country aims to achieve** self-sufficiency** in energy production.
 
 
 
• In the context, "achieved self-sufficiency in food grains" fits well as it indicates India's goal to be self-reliant and not depend on external sources for food. (खाद्यान्न में आत्मनिर्भरता)
 
 
• **Example:** Through various agricultural reforms, India achieved self-sufficiency in food grains by 1976.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **self-sufficiency**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Goal** (लक्ष्य): An aim or desired result.

 
 
• **Example:** Her goal is to become a successful doctor.
 
 
 
• **Incompetency** (अक्षम्यता): Inability to do something successfully.
 
 
• **Example:** His incompetency in handling critical issues was evident.
 
 
 
• **Success** (सफलता): The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** The project was a huge success due to the team's hard work.
 
 

36:Tf1f,
The correct answer is **Option 1**
